THE APPROPRIATION (RAILWAYS) SUPPLEMENTARY ORDINANCE, 1962
THE APPROPRIATION
(RAILWAYS) SUPPLEMENTARY ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No. XXXV
OF 1962
[2nd June, 1962]
An Ordinance to authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums in respect of Pakistan Railways from and out of the Federal
Consolidated Fund for the service of the period beginning on the first day of
July, 1961, and ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1962.
1. Short title.---This
Ordinance may be called the Appropriation (Rail ways) Supplementary Ordinance,
1962.

Issue of Rs. 81,79,000 out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the period beginning on the first day of July, 1961, and ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1962

THE APPROPRIATION (RAILWAYS) SUPPLEMENTARY ORDINANCE, 1962
THE APPROPRIATION
(RAILWAYS) SUPPLEMENTARY ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No. XXXV
OF 1962
[2nd June, 1962]
An Ordinance to authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums in respect of Pakistan Railways from and out of the Federal
Consolidated Fund for the service of the period beginning on the first day of
July, 1961, and ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1962.
2. Issue of Rs. 81,79,000 out
of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the period beginning on the first day of
July, 1961, and ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1962.--From and out of
the Federal Consolidated Fund there may be paid and applied sums not exceeding
those specified in column (3) of the Schedule to this Ordinance, amounting in
the aggregate to the sum of rupees eighty one lakhs and seventy nine thousands
towards defraying the several charges which will come in course of payment
during the period beginning on the first day of July, 1961, and ending on the
thirtieth day of June, 1962 in respect of Pakistan Railways for the services and
Pur poses specified in column (2) of the Schedule.

Appropriation

THE APPROPRIATION (RAILWAYS) SUPPLEMENTARY ORDINANCE, 1962

ORDINANCE No. XXXV

[2nd June, 1962]
An Ordinance to authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums in respect of Pakistan Railways from and out of the Federal
Consolidated Fund for the service of the period beginning on the first day of
July, 1961, and ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1962.
3. Appropriation.---The
sums authorised to be paid and applied from and out of the Federal Consolidated
Fund by this Ordinance shall lie appropriated in respect of Pakistan Railways
for the services and purposes expressed in the Schedule in relation to the
period specified in section 2.
